title: An Email from Sam
text:
Hi Lisa, how are you? I am in London now. The weather is cold and rainy. I like my new flat very much. It has a big window.

I miss you a lot. Can you visit me next month? We can go to the museum together. Write back soon! Love, Sam.

questions.text: What does Sam want Lisa to do?
How does Sam probably feel about his new flat?
What kind of text is this?
options: An informal email to a friend

vocabulary.definition: an opening in a wall with glass that lets in light
a building where people can see art or historical objects
the conditions outside, such as rain, sun or cold
to feel sad because a person is not with you

paragraph_translations: Cześć Lisa, jak się masz? Jestem teraz w Londynie. Pogoda jest zimna i deszczowa. Bardzo lubię moje nowe mieszkanie. Ma duże okno.
Bardzo za tobą tęsknię. Czy możesz mnie odwiedzić w przyszłym miesiącu? Możemy razem pójść do muzeum. Napisz szybko! Pozdrawiam, Sam.
